question: Excluding stoppages, the speed of a train is 45 km/h and including stoppages, it is 36 km/h. How many minutes does the train stop per hour?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train excluding stoppages = 45 km/h.

Speed of the train including stoppages = 36 km/h.

**Formula Used:**

Stopped time per hour = (frac{{Speed without stoppages} - {Speed with stoppages}}{{Speed without stoppages}}) times 60

**Calculation:**

Speed without stoppages = 45 km/h

Speed with stoppages = 36 km/h

Stopped time per hour = ((45 - 36)/(45)) times 60 

Stopped time per hour = ((9)/(45)) times 60 

Stopped time per hour = ((1)/(5)) times 60

Stopped time per hour = 12 minutes

**The train stops for 12 minutes per hour.**
